summary: Unify atomic adoption scope with verified managed paths

delivery.outcome: Use the hash-verified managed-file registry consistently in both adoption ownership gates
nonGoals: Do not exempt extendable or target-owned files
Do not trust intent-declared paths without lock and base verification

architecture.decision: Derive one verified adoption path set from the immutable package manifest, base lock, head lock and content digests, then pass that set to coordination and change-scope checks
interfaceChanges: Atomic adoption ownership uses the verified managed-path registry consistently
architecture.rollback: Revert the shared verified-path propagation while preserving fail-closed lock validation

validation.evidence: Cross-workstream managed adoption succeeds only for digest-verified paths

commands: for test_script in tests/*.test.sh; do bash "$test_script"; done
